name: qa-functional-testing-gherkin-postman
description: Projeto de testes funcionais Web e API com Gherkin, Postman/Newman, rastreabilidade e quality gate

scripts.ci: node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('reports',{recursive:true})" && newman run postman/Advantage_Search_API_Postman_Collection_v2.json --reporters cli,junit --reporter-junit-export reports/newman-report.xml && npm run quality:gate && npm run report:html
